messages.subject: shiny gadgets with leaflet
parts:
Hello all,

I was asking myself if is it possible to select  points by drag as outlined in the new features of shiny 0.13 (http://blog.rstudio.org/2016/01/20/shiny-0-13-0/#more-2434)
 but with leaflet?
 Has anyone already tried it or could provide some guidance on how to do it with leaflet?

Possible related question can be found here: http://stackoverflow.com/questions/34986212/area-select-event-for-r-leaflet-in-shiny/34988099?noredirect=1#comment57750505_34988099

 

Thanks in advance

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: shiny gadgets with leaflet
parts:
There's a pull request that's somewhat stalled, here:
https://github.com/rstudio/leaflet/pull/188

This is necessary in order to let you actually select points on Leaflet. Once it's merged then it would totally be possible to build these kinds of gadgets with Leaflet. You could already do one today if you wanted to where the selection was made by zooming/panning (though obviously click and drag would be nicer).
